node.title: Re: Any Alternative to HTML::TreeBuilder::XPath?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
What is your expected output? Perhaps you just need to implement a workaround:

use warnings; use strict; use HTML::TreeBuilder::XPath; use Data::Dump; my $tree= HTML::TreeBuilder::XPath->new; $tree->parse(<<'ENDHTML');
Foo Bar
Quz Baz
ENDHTML $tree->eof; dd map {$_->as_text} $tree->findnodes('/html/body//td'); dd $tree->findnodes_as_strings('/html/body//td'); __END__ ("Foo", "Bar", "Quz", "Baz") ("Foo", "Bar", "Quz", "Baz")
